summary: AppForge-LLM v4 is a Python/FastAPI package with packaged Vite/Vue assets and an existing appforge web entry point. The launcher change should add a root shell script around the existing source setup, frontend build, optional llm_bridge startup, and appforge web server rather than altering the web application architecture.
stack: Python package managed by pyproject.toml with console scripts appforge and appforge-web.
FastAPI/uvicorn web server in appforge/web.py serving packaged Vite assets from appforge/resources/web/.
Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript frontend under frontend/ with npm scripts dev, typecheck, build, and preview.
Optional Bun/TypeScript llm_bridge service under llm_bridge/ for APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge.
entry_points: pyproject.toml [project.scripts] exposes appforge = appforge.cli:app and appforge-web = appforge.web:main.
appforge/cli.py web command calls appforge.web.serve with --host, --port, --open-browser/--no-open-browser, and --log-level.
appforge/web.py serve constructs the FastAPI app and opens http://{host}:{port} via webbrowser when open_browser is true.
frontend/vite.config.ts builds production assets into appforge/resources/web/ for the FastAPI server to serve.
README.md and docs/WEB_APP.md currently document source startup as manual venv/pip/npm/appforge web commands.
architecture: The browser UI is a packaged SPA served by FastAPI; unknown non-API routes fall back to index.html.
The web API owns job state through appforge/web_jobs.py and persists runtime snapshots under .appforge-web/.
The control plane and quality gates remain in the Python appforge package; the web layer starts pipeline jobs but does not redefine pipeline completion.
The optional llm_bridge service is separate from the FastAPI process and is contacted through APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_URL when the llm-bridge driver path is selected.
A launcher can stay outside the Python package because it is developer/operator convenience, while tests can exercise it through shell syntax and smoke mode.
conventions: Keep source changes narrow and documented in README.md, docs/WEB_APP.md, and CHANGELOG.md when user-facing startup behavior changes.
Prefer existing commands instead of new dependencies: .venv/bin/appforge web, npm --prefix frontend run build, and bun run start for bridge startup.
Default local web binding should remain 127.0.0.1 and browser opening should be opt-out for smoke/CI paths.
Generated/runtime directories .venv, frontend/node_modules, llm_bridge/node_modules, .appforge-web, dist, and reports are ignored or treated as runtime artifacts.
Shell launcher should be POSIX-oriented bash with explicit failure handling and environment-variable overrides.
test_strategy: Run bash -n build.sh for syntax after adding the launcher.
Run a no-browser launcher smoke mode that starts appforge web, probes /api/health and /, then terminates the server.
Run .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q to protect backend/control-plane behavior.
Run npm --prefix frontend run typecheck and npm --prefix frontend run build to protect the packaged UI.
Run llm_bridge typecheck/tests if the launcher changes bridge-facing assumptions.
risk_areas: A launcher that installs dependencies on every run could slow the preferred UX; skip flags and node_modules checks should support fast repeat runs.
Opening a browser during automated checks is noisy; smoke mode must force no-browser behavior.

Starting llm_bridge unconditionally could require Bun or provider configuration for users who only need Codex/Claude/generic drivers; bridge startup should be opt-in or tied to APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge.
Background processes started during smoke checks must be cleaned up to avoid leaving occupied ports.
Port/host defaults must remain loopback-safe and configurable.
baseline_status: git status before product-code edits showed only AppForge control-plane changes for this new run: product_brief, checkpoint_intake, project metadata, request, and state.
.venv/bin/python -m appforge tool run detect_stack --project . passed and identified Python/FastAPI/pyproject.toml; it does not inspect nested frontend package.json.
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q passed: 23 tests, 1 Starlette TestClient deprecation warning.
No root build.sh/dev.sh/web.sh existed before this feature.
